title: Fix markdown tests for commonmarker 2.9.0's heading anchor markup
body:
Fixes #2181.

commonmarker 2.9.0 changed how it renders heading anchors: the anchor link now comes after the heading text instead of before, and uses `aria-label`/`data-heading-content` instead of `aria-hidden`. `test/markdown_test.rb` was asserting the exact pre-2.9 HTML shape, so every job that resolves commonmarker >= 2.9.0 fails, even though nothing about markdown rendering in this repo actually broke.

This adds a `commonmarker_v2_9_or_higher?` check next to the existing `commonmarker_v1_or_higher?` one, and asserts the correct expected markup for whichever version is actually resolved, so CI passes with both the pre- and post-2.9 output shape rather than needing the gem pinned to one or the other.
commits: Fix markdown tests for commonmarker 2.9.0's heading anchor markup
